title: BGP: improve PDU handling
description:
Use `tvb_find_guint16()` to quickly(?) find potential starting points
for the BGP marker, instead of doing repeated memory copies and
comparisons.

Use `tvb_memeql()` when testing for the BGP marker to avoid memory
copies.

Don't use a length of -1 when marking the start of the packet as
"Continuation."

Use `tcp_dissect_pdus()` in place of code which duplicates its
functionality. (N.B. this change causes additional messages in the TCP
tree of the form `[PDU Size: nn]` which were not created by the original
loop.)
